title: Avocado Goat Cheese Dip
description:
The mild creaminess of avocados, blended with the sharpness of goat cheese makes this dip irresistible.
Recipe Stats
ingredients: 3 ripe avocados – peeled, pitted and cut into chunks
directions: In a medium bowl, combine: avocados, garlic, cumin and salt.
Using an electric hand mixer, blend ingredients together.
Add lime juice, cream cheese and goat cheese, pulsing until smooth and blended well.
Add a bit more salt, if necessary.
Refrigerate until serving; serve cold with tortilla chips.
